title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Deductible Options, Minimums and Defaults
content:
Deductibles on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) are elected from a listed set per tier, subject to a minimum and a maximum. The minimum building deductible depends on the building limit: the lower minimum applies when the building limit is at or below the deductible threshold, the higher minimum when it exceeds that threshold. An application that elects no deductible takes the tier's default.

## Listed options

| Tier | Building and contents deductible options (USD) | Highest deductible on either coverage (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000 | 50000 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000 | 50000 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000 | 50000 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000 | 50000 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000, 25000 | 25000 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000, 25000 | 25000 |

The same list applies to the building deductible and to the contents deductible on each tier.

## Minimums, threshold and defaults

| Tier | Deductible threshold (building limit, USD) | Lower minimum building deductible (USD) | Higher minimum building deductible (USD) | Minimum contents deductible (USD) | Default building deductible (USD) | Default contents deductible (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | 100000 | 1000 | 1250 | 1000 | 2000 | 2000 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | 100000 | 1000 | 1250 | 1000 | 2000 | 2000 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | 100000 | 1000 | 1250 | 1000 | 2000 | 2000 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | 100000 | 1000 | 1250 | 1000 | 2000 | 2000 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | 100000 | 1000 | 1250 | 1000 | 2000 | 2000 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | 100000 | 1000 | 1250 | 1000 | 5000 | 5000 |

## Both sides of the threshold (hypothetical limits)

| Building limit written | Compared with 100000 | Minimum building deductible |
|---|---|---|
| 100,000 | at the threshold | 1000 |
| 100,100 | above the threshold | 1250 |
| 80,000 | below the threshold | 1000 |

A building limit exactly equal to the threshold takes the lower minimum.

## Parameter meanings

- Building deductible amounts that may be elected; list of USD.
- Contents deductible amounts that may be elected; list of USD.
- Minimum building deductible when the building limit is at or below the deductible threshold; USD.
- Minimum building deductible when the building limit exceeds the deductible threshold; USD.
- Building limit at or below which the lower minimum deductible applies; USD.
- Minimum contents deductible; USD. *Scoped exception:* For the contents deductible a contents proof of loss subtracts, and only for that deductible, the minimum follows the building limit the way the federal minimum deductibles pair the building and contents minimums: the higher minimum building deductible when the building limit is above the deductible threshold, and the tier's minimum contents deductible otherwise; every other minimum contents deductible remains the tier's minimum contents deductible.
- Building deductible applied when the application elects none; USD.
- Contents deductible applied when the application elects none; USD.
- Highest deductible that may be elected on either coverage; USD.
